param: B Constant influx (recruitment/birth) rate of human hosts into Sₕ at age a=0
μₕ Natural death rate of human hosts
μᵥ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
βₕ(a) Age-specific transmission/contact rate from infectious mosquitoes to susceptible humans
βᵥ(a) Age-specific transmission rate from infectious humans (Iₕ and Aₕ) to susceptible mosquitoes
k(a) Age-specific progression rate from exposed to infectious (inverse of latent period)
γ₁(a) Age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious humans
γ₂(a) Age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious humans
ρ Probability an exposed human becomes symptomatic infectious (Eₕ→Iₕ); (1-ρ) becomes asymptomatic (Eₕ→Aₕ)
σ Factor characterizing intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts (secondary infection modifier); also scales Aₕ contribution to mosquito infection in vector equation
Nₕ(t) Total human population size at time t (integral over ages of Sₕ+Eₕ+Iₕ+Aₕ+Rₕ)
Iᵥ(t) Proportion of infectious mosquitoes at time t (mosquito population rescaled to 1)
